set_value.name: $minLoad
set_value.exact: if $relaxed then 0 else if $waitAge ge 5min then [$cfg.$minCargoUsed,25].min else if $waitAge ge 2min then [$cfg.$minCargoUsed,50].min else $cfg.$minCargoUsed

set_value.name: $mwtrace_text
set_value.exact: 'SEARCH_OVERLAP previousAttempt=%s previousPhase=%s previousActorAlive=%s previousProgressAt=%s previousChecks=%s previousExpanded=%s conclusion=overlap_not_proof_of_abort'.[@$ship.pilot.$mwexM4Search.$attempt,@$ship.pilot.$mwexM4Search.$phase,@$ship.pilot.$mwexM4Search.$actor.exists,@$ship.pilot.$mwexM4Search.$progressAt,@$ship.pilot.$mwexM4Search.$checks,@$ship.pilot.$mwexM4Search.$expanded]

set_value.name: $mwtrace_text
set_value.exact: 'BEGIN build=beta.8 strategy=beta.7 home=%s minLoad=%s maxLots=%s maxJumps=%s corridor=%s preferOwned=%s wide=%s needOffset=%s sourceOffset=%s stockThreshold=%s allowAI=%s dedicated=%s corridorMarkup=%s'.[$home,$minLoad,$cfg.$maxTrades,$cfg.$maxDist,$cfg.$corridorDepth,$cfg.$allowPlayerSuppliers,@$ship.pilot.$mwexFleetSearchWide,@$ship.pilot.$mwexFleetNeedOffset,@$ship.pilot.$mwexFleetSearchOffset,$cfg.$playerStockThreshold,$cfg.$allowAiSuppliers,$cfg.$dedicatedServe,$cfg.$corridorMarkup]

set_value.name: $mwtrace_text
set_value.exact: 'WAIT_INPUT waveWait=%s waveWaitingSince=%s planWait=%s planWaitingSince=%s presentExpression=%s failures=%s misses=%s configuredMinLoad=%s effectiveMinLoad=%s relaxed=%s gradeRelaxed=%s'.[$debugWait,$debugWaitingSince,$waitAge,@$ship.pilot.$mwexFleetAttempt.$waitingSince,@$ship.pilot.$mwexFleetAttempt.$waitingSince?,@$ship.pilot.$mwexFleetAttempt.$failures,@$ship.pilot.$mwexFleetAttempt.$misses,$cfg.$minCargoUsed,$minLoad,$relaxed,$gradeRelaxed]

do_if.value: $cfg.$dedicatedServe and (($home.isclass.sector and $scope gt 1) or (not $home.isclass.sector and $scope gt 0))
$scope gt 0 and not $home.isclass.sector and $home.owner != faction.player and $owner.owner == faction.player
$scope gt 0 and ($home.isclass.sector or $home.owner == faction.player) and $owner.owner != faction.player

set_value.name: $mwtrace_text
set_value.exact: 'SOURCE_FILTER code=%s source=%s ware=%s rawAmount=%s needNet=unknown supplyNet=unknown stock=%s target=%s threshold=%s'.[$sourceFilterCode,$source,$ware,$source.amount,$source.owner.cargo.{$ware}.count,$source.owner.cargo.{$ware}.target,$cfg.$playerStockThreshold]

set_value.name: $mwtrace_text
set_value.exact: 'CANDIDATE need=%s receiver=%s source=%s supplier=%s ware=%s accepted=%s amount=%s needNet=%s supplyNet=%s buy=%s sell=%s code=%s reason=%s'.[$need,$need.owner.idcode,$source,$source.owner.idcode,$ware,not not $candidate,if $candidate then $candidate.$amount else 0,if @$cache.{$need}.$netKnown then $cache.{$need}.$net else 'unknown',if @$cache.{$source}.$netKnown then $cache.{$source}.$net else 'unknown',if @$cache.{$source}.$priceKnown then $cache.{$source}.$price/1Cr else 'unknown',if @$cache.{$need}.$priceKnown then $cache.{$need}.$price/1Cr else 'unknown',$candidateCode,$failure]

set_value.name: $mwtrace_text
set_value.exact: 'CANDIDATE_REFRESH source=%s need=%s ware=%s priorNeed=%s liveNeed=%s priorSupply=%s liveSupply=%s priorAmount=%s'.[$candidate.$source,$candidate.$need,$candidate.$ware,$candidate.$needNet,$liveNet.{$candidate.$need},$candidate.$sourceNet,$liveNet.{$candidate.$source},$candidate.$amount]

set_value.name: $mwtrace_text
set_value.exact: 'EXTEND depth=%s parentState=%s childState=%s shipBand=%s lotBand=%s main=%s source=%s need=%s ware=%s result=%s amount=%s volume=%s eta=%s score=%s'.[$depth,@$state.$logStateId,@$next.$logStateId,$candidate.$ownGrade,$candidate.$grade,if $state.$plan.count then $state.$plan.{1}.$source else $candidate.$source,$candidate.$source,$candidate.$need,$candidate.$ware,$extensionReason,if $next then $next.$plan.{$next.$plan.count}.$amount else 0,if $next then $next.$volume else 0,if $next then $next.$time else 0,if $next then $next.$score else 0]

do_if.value: $next.$accepted and (not $best or $quality gt $bestQuality or ($quality == $bestQuality and $next.$penalty lt $best.$penalty))

set_value.name: $mwtrace_text
set_value.exact: 'BEST depth=%s volume=%s capacity=%s lots=%s ownedVolume=%s etaWeight=%s score=%s quality=%s penalty=%s'.[$depth,$next.$volume,$next.$capacity,$next.$plan.count,$next.$ownedVolume,$next.$time,$next.$score,$quality,$next.$penalty]

do_if.value: $ship.orders.count or not $ship.isoperational or $ship.defaultorder != $cfg.$origin or $ship.pilot.$mwexFleetCfg.$signature != $cfg.$signature or ($cfg.$origin.id == 'SupplyMule' and $cfg.$origin.$home != $home)

set_value.name: $diagnostic.$stop
set_value.exact: if $result.$volume ge $result.$capacity then 1 else if $result.$plan.count == $cfg.$maxTrades then 2 else 0

set_value.name: $diagnostic.$status
set_value.exact: if $best then 'planned' else if $diagnostic.$budgetExhausted then 'budget' else if $diagnostic.$loadRejected then 'load' else if $diagnostic.$gradeDeferred gt 0 then 'grade_wait' else 'no_candidate'

set_value.name: $mwtrace_text
set_value.exact: 'LIMITS wait=%s minLoad=%s gradeRelaxed=%s gradeDeferred=%s demand=%sm3 supply=%sm3 receiverRejects=%s corridorRejects=%s lotLimit=%s budget=%s coarseBuilds=%s coarseHits=%s'.[$waitAge,$minLoad,$gradeRelaxed,$diagnostic.$gradeDeferred,$diagnostic.$demandVolume,$diagnostic.$supplyVolume,$diagnostic.$receiverBlocked,$diagnostic.$range,$diagnostic.$lotLimited,$diagnostic.$budgetExhausted,$diagnostic.$coarseBuilds,$diagnostic.$coarseHits]

set_value.name: $mwtrace_text
set_value.exact: 'END status=%s elapsed=%s checks=%s pool=%s extensions=%s secondaryTried=%s secondaryAdded=%s candidateBudget=%s routeBudget=%s volume=%s eta=%s score=%s'.[$diagnostic.$status,player.age-$diagnostic.$started,$checks,$pool.count,$diagnostic.$expanded,$diagnostic.$secondaryChecks,$diagnostic.$secondaryAdded,$diagnostic.$candidateBudget,$diagnostic.$routeBudget,$diagnostic.$volume,@$diagnostic.$eta,@$diagnostic.$score]

set_value.name: $mwtrace_text
set_value.exact: 'DRAFT_LEG index=%s source=%s need=%s ware=%s amount=%s buy=%sCr sell=%sCr'.[$i,$leg.$source,$leg.$need,$leg.$ware,$leg.$amount,$leg.$buyprice/1Cr,$leg.$sellprice/1Cr]

set_value.name: $mwtrace_text
set_value.exact: 'RESULT status=aborted success=false reason=script_interrupted stage=plan phase=%s checks=%s expanded=%s progressAt=%s actor=%s cause=unknown'.[@$diagnostic.$phase,@$diagnostic.$checks,@$diagnostic.$expanded,@$diagnostic.$progressAt,this]
